blogs.title: QLoRA in Plain English: Fine-tuning 65B Models on a Single GPU
blogs.description: A high-level tour of how QLoRA makes giant language models trainable on a single 48GB GPU without losing 16-bit quality. Covers the core idea: backprop through a frozen 4-bit base model into lightweight LoRA adapters, plus the big wins in memory and training time.

blogs.title: Meet NF4: The 4-bit format that keeps big models smart
blogs.description: Explains NormalFloat4 (NF4) for non-experts—why modeling weights as normally distributed lets you pack them into 4 bits with minimal loss. Compares NF4 to FP4/Int4, shows why zero matters, and summarizes the paper’s evidence that NF4 preserves accuracy.

blogs.title: Double Quantization, Explained: Compressing the scale of your scales
blogs.description: Demystifies double quantization: quantizing not just the weights, but also the quantization constants. Uses simple analogies and numbers (saving ~0.37 bits per parameter on 65B models) to show how QLoRA cuts memory without harming performance.

blogs.title: Beating Out-of-Memory Errors: How Paged Optimizers tame memory spikes
blogs.description: Breaks down paged optimizers and NVIDIA unified memory in plain terms. Shows how QLoRA survives long-sequence spikes during gradient checkpointing, keeps speed comparable, and makes single-GPU finetuning far more reliable.

blogs.title: The LoRA Recipe That Matches Full Fine-tuning
blogs.description: Unpacks the paper’s key finding: default LoRA settings aren’t enough for large LLMs. Explains why adding adapters across all linear layers (not just attention q,v) and right-sizing r, batch, and LR helps QLoRA recover full 16-bit performance.

blogs.title: Building Guanaco: An open chatbot that nearly matches ChatGPT in a day
blogs.description: Tells the story of Guanaco, QLoRA’s showcase model family. Walks through training on OASST1, results on Vicuna (up to 99.3% of ChatGPT), and the surprising power of small, high-quality data. Highlights deployment footprints as low as ~5GB.

blogs.title: Why Data Quality Beats Size: MMLU vs Chatbot performance
blogs.description: Translates the paper’s large-scale study into plain insights: dataset suitability matters more than size. Shows how models that excel at MMLU aren’t necessarily great chatbots (and vice versa), and what that means for choosing finetuning data.

blogs.title: Who Judges the Judges? Humans vs GPT-4 in model evaluation
blogs.description: Explains the tournament-style, Elo-based evaluation used in the paper and what it reveals about reliability. Covers order effects, where GPT-4 and humans agree (and don’t), and practical tips to run better, cheaper evaluations.

blogs.title: Hands-on Guide: Fine-tune LLaMA with QLoRA on a single GPU
blogs.description: A practical walkthrough for practitioners: setup with Transformers and bitsandbytes, picking datasets, recommended hyperparameters, handling long sequences, and what to expect in time, cost, and memory for 7B–65B models.

blogs.title: Beyond the Lab: What QLoRA means for open AI, phones, and privacy
blogs.description: Looks at the broader impact: democratizing finetuning for researchers and startups, enabling on-device customization, and the dual-use challenges. Summarizes what’s open-sourced and how QLoRA could reshape the LLM ecosystem.
